title: A repeated 402 releases and re-plans; the second attempt commits
description: The nominal T-010 path. The first signed attempt is answered with a fresh 402: the merchant is still asking to be paid, which is evidence that nothing settled, so the reservation is released and the loop is allowed another attempt. The second delivers with a successful PAYMENT-RESPONSE and commits. An implementation that retained the first reservation would count the same purchase twice against the rolling hourly cap even though only one payment ever settled.
